build_TaskAlignedAssigner: build a TaskAlignedAssigner with topk parameter and default BboxOverlaps2D IoU calculator for object detection
assign_gt_to_bboxes: assign ground truth bounding boxes to predicted bboxes using alignment metrics with configurable alpha and beta
compute_alignment_metrics: compute alignment metrics between predicted bboxes and ground truth using bbox scores and IoU overlaps
select_topk_candidates: select top-k candidate bounding boxes for each ground truth based on alignment metric scores
review_TaskAlignedAssigner_assign: review the TaskAlignedAssigner assign method to understand positive sample center constraint logic
